descriptions.value: The Thrive Automator WordPress plugin before 11.2 does not properly sanitize and escape a parameter's array key before using it in a SQL query, allowing authenticated attackers with editor-level access to perform blind SQL injection attacks.

assertions.title: Thrive Automator < 11.2 - Editor+ Blind SQLi via 'additional' Parameter

descriptions.description: CWE-89 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

title: Thrive Automator < 11.2 - Editor+ Blind SQLi via 'additional' Parameter

descriptions.value: Jenkins 2.587 and earlier, LTS 2.580.1 and earlier allows requests authenticated using HTTP Basic authentication, including with an API token, to obtain a "remember me" cookie, allowing attackers who have obtained a user's API token to retain access to Jenkins using a "remember me" cookie after the API token is revoked or expires.
Missing authorization in Azure CycleCloud allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

title: Azure CycleCloud Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability

descriptions.description: CWE-59: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
